normal.name: Judeau (EatTheRich)
normal.text: I really like a good thumb operated #trackball mouse like the #Protoarc EM01 and the old #Logitech one with the green ball that I have used for years. It's still a pain however needing to occasionally pop the ball out and clean the sensors and that got me to thinking... Do they make a trackball mouse like these but in place of the ball is a thumb pad / track pad like on the Steam Deck? Even better if it also includes haptic feedback like the #SteamDeck. I feel like this would be the perfect mouse. If this is not a thing, is there any good reason that it does not exist? #AskFedi #Steam

normal.name: Jakob Fel
normal.text: Has anyone played the Gothic remake yet? I haven't had the chance to play it or the original, but I do have almost all of Piranha Bytes' games in my Steam library and I'm trying to decide whether I should try to tweak/mod the original Gothic or just play the remake. I've heard people say the remake is amazing and I've also heard you need quite a few mods to make the original work correctly. :odysee_thinking: #RetroGames #rpg #2000s #Steam #pcgaming

normal.name: The Boss Rush Network
normal.text: In this clip from the Boss Rush Podcast, Nick Dimitrescu, Corey Dirrig, and LeRon Dawkins explore Steam OS's open-source Linux sandbox and Valve's ambitious push toward ARM architecture support. While Nick acknowledges how huge an ARM-compatible Steam OS could be for mobile and handheld gaming, he weighs in on whether claims that Steam OS will completely replace Windows are realistic or overly ambitious. #BossRushPodcast #BossRushLive #SteamOS #LinuxGaming #PCGaming

normal.name: John Cormier 🇨🇦
normal.text: Started playing Solasta: Crown of the Magister last night. The character creation process is decent, though I didn’t appreciate how some interesting classes and species are greyed out. There’s no obvious rationale, so I assume it’s so the developers can rake in a few extra $. Not far in yet, but really enjoying the game. #videogames #steam
